newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine police seize airplane used for smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Argentine police seize airplane used for smuggling.

text.p: Argentine police Wednesday seized an airplane at Ezeiza, the country's main international airport, for carrying smuggled goods, a judge said.

The aircraft, which is owned by an Argentine-Uruguayan company, was used by a criminal ring and has transported some 40 tonnes of contraband from Uruguay to Argentina so far this year, Judge Jorge Brugo told the state news agency Telam.
Argentina recently launched a high-profile campaign to crack down on corruption and false valuations of goods by the country's customs services.
